g.text: THE DUCT IS SIZED BY A PRESSURE BUDGET
A duct is not sized by the room. It is sized by a pressure budget.
What the blower has left over, divided by the longest run, is the friction rate.
Fittings are most of that run: an elbow can be 15 to 35 ft of equivalent length.
And the air has to get back. A closed door with no way out chokes its own supply.
Loads, sizes and the house are fictional.
supply trunk 14 in down the hall, one branch and one register a room
RA is the one central return; each closed room needs an undercut or grille
its share of the load, not its floor
0.16 in wg - that is the budget
is sized against that one number
an elbow can be 15 to 35 ft of length
air that goes in has to get out
